# Test m1 observable behaviors
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver import Version

# Test cases from m1 spec
v1 = Version.parse('1.0.0-rc9')
result1 = v1.bump_prerelease()
print(f"rc9 bump_prerelease: {result1} (expected: 1.0.0-rc9.0)")
assert str(result1) == '1.0.0-rc9.0', f"FAIL: got {result1}"

v2 = Version.parse('1.0.0-rc.9')
result2 = v2.bump_prerelease()
print(f"rc.9 bump_prerelease: {result2} (expected: 1.0.0-rc.10)")
assert str(result2) == '1.0.0-rc.10', f"FAIL: got {result2}"

v3 = Version.parse('1.0.0-alpha')
result3 = v3.bump_prerelease()
print(f"alpha bump_prerelease: {result3} (expected: 1.0.0-alpha.0)")
assert str(result3) == '1.0.0-alpha.0', f"FAIL: got {result3}"

# Verify ordering: before < after
assert Version.compare(v1, result1) < 0, "FAIL: rc9 should be less than rc9.0"
assert Version.compare(v2, result2) < 0, "FAIL: rc.9 should be less than rc.10"
assert Version.compare(v3, result3) < 0, "FAIL: alpha should be less than alpha.0"

# Also test existing behavior still works
v4 = Version.parse('3.4.5')
print(f"no prerelease bump_prerelease: {v4.bump_prerelease()}")
print(f"no prerelease bump_prerelease(''): {v4.bump_prerelease('')}")
print(f"no prerelease bump_prerelease(None): {v4.bump_prerelease(None)}")

print("\nAll m1 tests passed!")
